description: This file contains integration tests for the Loan Application Approval process in the Fineract system, including positive and negative test cases for loan approval amounts, multi-disbursal loans, and specific transaction strategies.

classes.name: LoanApplicationApprovalTest
classes.description: This class contains test cases for verifying loan application approval workflows, including amount validation, multi-disbursal handling, and configuration enforcement.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured setup, request specifications, and test helpers before each test.

methods.name: loanApplicationApprovedAmountLessThanProposedAmount
methods.description: Tests the scenario where the approved amount is less than the proposed amount, expecting the loan to be in 'Waiting for Disbursal' status.

methods.name: loanApplicationApprovedAmountGreaterThanProposedAmount
methods.description: Tests the scenario where the approved amount exceeds the proposed amount, expecting an error message.

methods.name: createTrancheDetail
methods.description: Creates a HashMap representing a single tranche detail with date and amount.

methods.name: loanApplicationApprovalAndValidationForMultiDisburseLoans
methods.description: Performs tests for multi-disbursal loan approvals and their validation constraints.

methods.name: loanApplicationShouldFailIfTransactionProcessingStrategyIsAdvancedPaymentAllocationButItIsNotConfiguredOnProduct
methods.description: Tests that approval fails if the advanced payment allocation strategy is used without proper product configuration.

methods.name: trancheLoansApprovedAmountLesserThanProposedAmount
methods.description: Helper method testing multi-tranche loan approval when approved amount is less than proposed.

methods.name: trancheLoansApprovalValidation
methods.description: Helper method testing validation constraints during tranche loan approval.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Creates and submits a loan application for a client with collateral and returns the loan ID.

methods.name: addCollaterals
methods.description: Associates collateral details with a loan application.

methods.name: collaterals
methods.description: Generates a HashMap of collateral details for an application.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplicationWithTranches
methods.description: Creates a multi-tranche loan application for a client and returns the loan ID.
